scope: 33 named catalog operations; executable build coverage, not elapsed effort or live readiness.

definition.BUILT: Concrete executable implementation exists for the named operation contract; provider/capture/input credentials and deferred proof alone are not missing code.
definition.PARTIAL: Concrete executable implementation exists but identified requested features within its area lack native schema/action/dispatch.
definition.GENERIC_ONLY: Named operation has only generic recorded-profile execution, without a dedicated implementation.

missing_executable_features: No executable dedicated native variant/traffic handler. Actual control/variant identity, creation/save and traffic allocation captures are still required.
